title: No-Slip Vanishing-Viscosity Limit in the Energy Norm
exact_target: Do all no-slip viscous flows converge in the uniform-in-time energy norm to the smooth inviscid flow as viscosity vanishes?

sources.citation: Y. Maekawa and A. Mazzucato, The Inviscid Limit and Boundary Layers for Navier-Stokes Flows (2016).
